name: URLpipe API
description: Every endpoint takes a JSON body with a `url`. Requests are asynchronous by default: the response is a token, and the result is delivered to `report_to` (or the project's default webhook) and can be fetched with GET /result/{token}. Send `sync: true` to get the result in the response instead. Full documentation: https://urlpipe.dev/docs
